source_refs.note: Topic 2.6.2, printed page 33: the p orbitals (Figure 2.6).

blocks.text: The electron density of a 2p orbital is not distributed in a spherically symmetric way as in an s orbital. Instead a p orbital has two lobes on one of the axes. The three p orbitals are named px, py and pz according to their axes.

blocks.alt: Three sets of axes, each with a dumbbell-shaped p orbital: 2px along the x axis, 2py along the y axis and 2pz along the z axis. Each has a darker + lobe and a lighter - lobe on opposite sides of the nucleus with a nodal plane between them. The printed labels give l = 1 with m = +1, -1 and 0.
blocks.caption: Shapes of the three 2p orbitals (original diagram after Figure 2.6).
